title: Saving re-evaluates thresholds at once; undo offered; returns to the tab
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View and edit customers, on the build under test.
  2. An asset exists that has a mileage and engine-hours history (e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab; a work order carrying the same asset is also available.
custom_steps:
1. Enter a new reading and Save.
  2. Watch the services and thresholds on the maintenance tab.
  3. Look for an undo control after saving.
  4. Note where the dialog returns to and whether it forecasts anything.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Saving re-evaluates every dependent threshold immediately, not overnight.
  • An undo appears after saving.
  • The reading modal forecasts nothing; saving returns to the maintenance tab, which already shows every service the reading moved.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10567 (S10, Enter a reading); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S10; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R5: “Saving will re-evaluate every dependent threshold immediately, not overnight”
  • S10-R7: “An undo will appear after saving”
  • S10-N4: “The reading modal forecasts nothing. Saving returns to the maintenance tab, which already shows every service the reading moved, with room to show it properly”
